corrections.text: The headline says the "MCP Working Group" published the draft. The cited sources name the body the File Uploads Working Group: the repository README says the extension is "Maintained by the File Uploads Working Group" and the MCP blog post says the project "bootstrapped the File Uploads Working Group". The article body does not name it.

The summary says the extension would let clients upload and download files for tools "out of band". The draft also lets a client send a small file inline, within the server's advertised maxInlineBytes; only files above that limit go out of band, as the body of the article explains.
